content.name: Giorgos Sabanis
content.description: Giorgos Sabanis is a Greek singer and songwriter. His recordings include Haramata, Mistirio Treno, Logia Pou Kaine and Paraxena Demenoi. Universal Music France’s artist page links his Spotify catalogue.
